mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BATGERS_MATCH_PARENT(gamers, healers, isLive, bet) VALUES (#{gamers}, #{healers}, true, ${bet})
INSERT INTO BATGERS_MATCH_CHILD (parentCd, gameCd, loser) VALUES (#{parentCd}, #{gameCd}, #{loser})
mapper.select: SELECT a.matchNo, a.gameCd, b.gameNm, a.loser, c.playerNm AS loserNm, DATE_FORMAT(a.regDate, '%Y-%m-%d %T') AS regDate FROM BATGERS_MATCH_CHILD AS a INNER JOIN BATGERS_GAME_LIST AS b ON a.gameCd = b.idx INNER JOIN BATGERS_PLAYER_LIST AS c ON a.loser = c.playerNo WHERE parentCd = #{parentCd} ORDER BY a.matchNo

SELECT c.playerNo, d.playerNm, IF(INSTR(a.healers, c.playerNo) > 0, 1, 0) AS isHealer, c.matchNo, c.playerNm AS gamerNm, c.mmr, c.mmrDelta, c.loserFlag, c.winPlace, c.damageDealt, (0 - c.damagePenalty) AS damagePenalty, c.kills, c.dbnos, c.assists, c.revives, c.teamKills, c.timeSurvived FROM BATGERS_MATCH_PARENT AS a INNER JOIN BATGERS_MATCH_CHILD AS b ON a.idx = b.parentCd INNER JOIN BATGERS_MATCH_PUBG_DETAIL AS c ON b.matchNo = c.matchNo INNER JOIN BATGERS_PLAYER_LIST AS d ON c.playerNo = d.playerNo WHERE a.idx = #{parentCd} ORDER BY c.idx
